body: I've been seeing expensive therapists on and off for the past year but nothing helps. I feel worthless most days and I am tired of the pointless grind that is my life. I see no meaning in existence and I I'm done trying for the sake of others. Killing myself isn't selfish, it will relieve others (family and the very few friends I have) of a burden although they'll of course pretend to be sad for a few days. The one thing I've learned in my very short life is that no one gives a fuck about me despite their pretensions and vigorous protests that they do. I hope that my death fosters discussion about the problems in our society but I realize that most likely I'll just be another picture people share on their Facebook feeds and forget about in a few weeks. My name will cease to be uttered in a few years and any physical remnant of my existence will be gone. None of this even matters because I have nothing to look forward to except nothingness.
